D: A man who can't make new memories hunts his wife's killer with Polaroids, notes and tattoos, and the story runs backwards.
P: Serve the steak when Jimmy offers Leonard the 200 grand in the car.
S: Instant Polaroid grilled cheese with tomato soup
Grilled cheese with tomato soup to dip. Polaroid of everyone.

Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend smooth, stir in the cream and season. Butter the outsides of the bread, fill with the cheddar and mozzarella, and press the parmesan onto the buttered sides. Cook in a pan under a weight until crisp and melting, then trim into neat squares like little Polaroids and serve with shot glasses of soup.
Corn chips loaded with beans and melted cheese. Burt rents out a second room.

Warm the beans with the cumin and a splash of water, mashing a few. Mix the tomato and red onion with half the lime juice and a pinch of salt. Layer the chips, beans and cheese twice in a baking dish and bake at 200C until the cheese bubbles. Mash the avocado with the rest of the lime, then top the nachos with salsa, jalapenos, avocado and sour cream.
M: Two hundred grand steak frites with peppercorn sauce
Steak frites with peppercorn sauce. Jimmy's cash in the Jaguar's trunk.

Fry the chips at 150C until soft but pale, then lift out and drain. Season the steaks and sear in a very hot pan for 3 to 4 minutes a side for medium rare, then rest. Melt the butter in the steak pan, soften the shallot and peppercorns, add the brandy and let it bubble off. Add the cream and mustard and simmer until it coats a spoon. Fry the chips again at 190C until crisp, salt them and serve with the steak and sauce.
1kg floury potatoes, cut in thin fries@Produce
2 tbsp green peppercorns in brine, drained@Pantry
W: Pineapple upside-down cake, baked bottom first. The colour scenes run in reverse.

Pour the melted butter into a 22cm cake tin, scatter over the brown sugar and lay the pineapple rings on top with a cherry in each hole. Beat the softened butter and caster sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs and vanilla. Fold in the flour and milk and spread the batter over the fruit. Bake at 180C until a skewer comes out clean. Rest for 5 minutes, turn out upside down and serve warm with the cream.
K: Cold lager with a bourbon chaser. He drinks it even after Natalie spits in it.
Pour the lager into 4 chilled glasses. Pour 30ml bourbon into each shot glass and serve on the side.
